ground_truth.description: The refactor silently changes FakeScheduler's cache semantics. Previously `_status_cache` was an empty dict that `set_task_status` never populated, so the workflow's `cached in TERMINAL_STATUSES` check always saw `None` and re-queued. The new `get_cached_status` returns `history[-1]` (the actual last status), so if the last status is terminal the workflow now takes the 'not re-queueing' branch. This is a behavioral divergence in a refactor claimed to be behavior-preserving, and can alter which code path e2e tests exercise.

The added `assert result is not None` is redundant — an identical assertion already exists three lines earlier (line 681) and no code between them reassigns `result`. It adds nothing and is dead/duplicated code.
`from typing import TYPE_CHECKING` is added but there is no visible usage in the diff; if nothing in the file references it, this is an unused import that will trip linters.

task.description:

2. Replace runtime hasattr/isinstance conformance tests in test_workflow_e2e.py with static TYPE_CHECKING assertions that catch method signature drift.
